name: namo provisioning rules
principle: A pod is only born when it will boot, and dies the moment it will not. Money is spent in seconds, not minutes.

hard_rules.rule: No pod is created without a named GPU type, a named datacenter, and a precomputed max cost.
hard_rules.check: create() refuses if any of the three is missing

hard_rules.rule: A pod that has not reported uptime > 0 within BOOT_TIMEOUT_S is deleted immediately.
hard_rules.check: poll() kills at 60 s; bill is capped at 60 s * rate

hard_rules.rule: A pod must be in a datacenter that holds the network volume. No exceptions.
Volume size is set from the measured plan, never guessed. Current need is 94.05 GB.
A pod is never created if the remaining balance cannot pay for MAX_MINUTES at its rate.
Only one pod may exist at a time. A second create() deletes the first.
A pod with no GPU (uptime<0 after boot) is a defect, not a retry loop. Delete, log the GPU, move to the next candidate.
hard_rules.check: on failure: delete, blacklist that gpu+dc for the run

hard_rules.rule: Idle rule: a working pod is kept warm for IDLE_MIN minutes after its last job, then terminated. Never killed mid-work.
Every rupee spent is written to a ledger with pod id, gpu, dc, seconds, rate, cost.
A stage that produces nothing in STALL_S is failed, not waited on.

candidate_order.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
candidate_order.why: cheapest verified card that fits 52.3 GB weights with batch headroom

throughput_model.weights_source: measured sum: unet_pruned_int8 20.97 + qwen3vl_int8 27.14 + video_vae 2.81 + audio_vae 0.61 + turbo_lora 0.78

vram_rule.note: concurrent shots = (vram - weights) / per_shot_gb; a card below weights_gb yields 0
vram_rule.24gb_card: 0 concurrent - model does not fit, forbidden

per_shot_s.source: derived from measured 499 s at 768p/4-step/6 s, scaled to 480x864/6-step

batch.rule: never assume batch N gives Nx; price at 1.6x

session_overhead_min.rule: a session must produce >=8 episodes or the overhead share exceeds 11%

session_policy.because: 1 episode = 40 min work + 38 min overhead = 51% waste; 8 episodes = 11% waste
session_policy.plan_batch: queue episodes so one pod run drains at least 8

forbidden.reason: 24-48 GB cannot hold 52.3 GB of weights; a pod on them is a guaranteed failure
forbidden.except: smoke test of boot only, never a render

unverified_claims.A100_pcie_1.39_per_hr: checked 12 DCs, secure and community: no price. Do not plan on it.
